description: 003 - ORES Electricité - Nb points prélèvement par localité et type client tension (Annuel) is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ORES. Afin de mesurer l’impact de ses Open Data, Ores est intéressée d’être tenue informée des réutilisations qui seront faites des données mises à disposition. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are électricité, ore, client. The portal shows 25,610 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-02-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
